title: docs(check:published-dist): state the tsbuildinfo default rule instead of asserting the package root
body:
Fixes #9329

`scripts/check-published-dist-tooling.mjs`'s `tooling-in-published-output` hint told a reader
whose package had shipped a `*.tsbuildinfo` build record that they could point `tsBuildInfoFile`
outside the published output **"or leave it at its default (the package root)"**. That second
half is false for exactly the packages that can trigger the finding.

## The premise, re-derived rather than inherited

Not taken from the card. Re-measured on this branch's base (`cb725e78fb`) with TypeScript 6.0.3's
own `getTsBuildInfoEmitOutputFilePath`, over the 94 tracked `*tsconfig*.json` files:

| population | count |
| --- | --- |
| tracked tsconfigs | 94 |
| incremental projects (derive a record at all) | **32** |
| default derives **inside its `outDir`** | **19** |
| default derives inside a **published build output dir** (`dist`/`build`/`.next`) | **18** |
| default derives at the **package root** | 13 |

The card's `32` / `18` reproduce exactly. The 19th `outDir` project is
`apps/console/tsconfig.node.json`, whose `outDir` is `node_modules/.cache/tsc/console-node` —
inside its `outDir`, but not inside a published directory.

## The discriminant is NOT simply `rootDir`

The card proposed replacing the parenthetical with *"it is the package root only when `rootDir`
is set"*. **That replacement is also wrong**, in both directions. Synthetic configs, one per cell,
default derivation shown:

| config | derived default | inside `dist`? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `outDir: dist`, no `rootDir` | `dist/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` | yes |
| `outDir: dist`, `rootDir: src` | `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` | no (package root) |
| `outDir: dist`, **`rootDir: "."`** | `dist/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` | **yes — `rootDir` IS set** |
| **no `outDir`**, no `rootDir` | `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` | **no — and no `rootDir`** |
| `outDir: dist`, `rootDir: src/deep` | `../tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` | no — escapes the package |

Both counter-cells are real here, not hypothetical: `packages/components/tsconfig.json` is the
`outDir`-without-`rootDir` cell (default `packages/components/dist/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`), and
`apps/site/tsconfig.json` is the no-`outDir` cell — it sets no `rootDir` and still derives to its
own package root (`apps/site/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`).

So the hint now states **the derivation** rather than any fixed location or single discriminant:
TypeScript takes the tsconfig's own path, swaps in `.tsbuildinfo`, and remaps it from `rootDir`
into `outDir`; it is the package root only when no `outDir` is set, or when `rootDir` happens to
rebase it back out. The operative remedy is the first half — set the option explicitly.

## `BUILD_RECORD` docblock — measured, and NOT the same defect

The card left this open. Measured: a multiline sweep over all 7 587 tracked text files finds the
string `leave it at its default` **exactly once in the repository** — the hint at line 455. The
`BUILD_RECORD` docblock makes no claim about where the default goes; it documents what the regex
recognises. `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` mirrors only the true half of the sentence
("names every input path on the machine that produced it"). Nothing else to fix, so nothing else
touched.

## No behaviour changed

- 13 module exports compared PRE vs POST by value (regex sources, constants, function arity):
  **0 differences**; a deliberately injected fake change made the comparator report 1, so the
  comparison can see a difference.
- The gate's own counters are identical PRE and POST: 39 published packages, 6021 tarball files,
  5865 build output, **0 tooling artifacts**.
- No `.json` touched: no tsconfig, no package config, no threshold, no gate logic.

## Pin tests

Swept for them before editing. **No test pins this hint's wording.** The `HINTS` identifier has
36 hits repo-wide (a non-empty reader), none of them in a test that reads *this* gate's `HINTS`;
the one test that does parse a `HINTS` object (`scripts/__tests__/check-doc-links.test.ts`) reads
`scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` by explicit path. `check-published-dist-tooling.test.ts` asserts
finding *reasons* and behaviour, never hint text.

## Verification

| check | PRE | POST |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node scripts/check-published-dist-tooling.mjs` | exit 0 | exit 0 |
| `check-published-dist-tooling.test.ts` + `tsbuildinfo-outside-published-dist-9189.test.ts` + `check-published-tsconfig-tooling-exclude.test.ts` | exit 0 (62 tests) | exit 0 |
| the three above + `check-doc-links.test.ts` | — | exit 0 (183 tests) |
| `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:shell-escape-residue` | — | exit 0 each |
| `check:changeset-claims`, `changeset:check` | — | exit 0 |
| `eslint scripts/check-published-dist-tooling.mjs --no-inline-config` | — | exit 0 |

Exit codes captured by redirect-then-capture, never across a pipe.

`prettier --check` is red on this file — but it is **equally red on the HEAD bytes** at the same
path (verified in place, with a hash-verified restore), so it is pre-existing and not introduced
here.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — `check:published-dist` 红灯时打印的那段补救说明。原文让读者"把
`tsBuildInfoFile` 指到发布目录外,或者干脆留默认值(包根目录)";破折号后半句被替换成
TypeScript 真实的推导规则。只改了一个字符串字面量,外加一份 internal-only changeset。

**为什么改** — 后半句对**恰好会触发这条红灯的那批包**是假的。用 TypeScript 自己的
`getTsBuildInfoEmitOutputFilePath` 在本分支基点上重新测量:32 个 incremental 项目里,19 个设了
`outDir` 却没设 `rootDir`,它们的默认记录落在 `outDir` 里面,其中 18 个落在已发布目录内。读者照
这句话做,复现的正是这条红灯本身。更要紧的是:卡片建议的替换句(「只有设了 `rootDir` 才是包根」)
**同样是错的** —— `rootDir: "."` 配 `outDir: "dist"` 仍然落进 `dist`;而本仓库的 `apps/site`
没设 `rootDir`,却因为压根没有 `outDir` 而落在包根。所以新文案不再给任何固定位置或单一判据,
只陈述推导本身。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 风险极低:门禁逻辑、阈值、任何 `tsconfig.json` 与包配置都没动;
13 个模块导出值 PRE/POST 逐项比对为 0 差异,门禁计数前后完全一致(39 个包、0 个 tooling 产物)。
没有任何 pin 测试钉这段文案(已在动手前扫过)。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit,无迁移、无数据面影响。

**席位意见** — (留空,待维护者/席位定稿)

**你要做的** — 确认新文案的口径可以接受;特别是确认「不给单一判据、只陈述推导」这个取舍,
比卡片原本建议的「只有设了 `rootDir` 才是包根」更合适 —— 后者经实测为假。
